_comment: navya-2 run config: 1.31B (dim 2048 x 26, GQA 16/4, tied 64k vocab). ~130B tokens = 31,000 steps x 4.194M global batch (~99 tok/param). act_ckpt off (fits an 80GB GPU at micro-batch 4, ce_chunk 1024). Cosine to 10% + cooldown last 15% (step 26,350+). LR 5e-4, warmup 1000. max_steps is throughput-gated: run a 30-min smoke, measure MFU, set max_steps to land in the 120-150B target. Data: data/navya2_v1 virtual stream (FineWeb-Edu int_score>=4, Indic floor 18%, math/code/finance).
